# C unit tests (Unity) and examples of the generated bindings (include/, generated by `mise run generate:bindings`),
# run with CTest.
# Expects the Rust library to be built first (`cargo build -p ecitygml-ffi`); `mise run build:bindings:c` does both.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ecitygml_ffi_c LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(REPOSITORY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../..")
set(ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR "${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/target/debug" CACHE PATH "Directory with libecitygml_ffi")
set(FIXTURES "${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/tests/fixtures")

find_library(ECITYGML_FFI ecitygml_ffi PATHS "${ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    Unity
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity.git
    GIT_TAG v2.7.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Unity)
# Without it, Unity compiles the double assertions (envelope sizes, volumes) to ignored tests.
target_compile_definitions(unity PUBLIC UNITY_INCLUDE_DOUBLE)

enable_testing()

# Unit tests, built with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. C users destroy every object
# themselves; the sanitizers make a test fail on double destroys, on memory errors in the C code and, on Linux,
# on leaks (LeakSanitizer; not available on macOS). Reads of destroyed objects inside the Rust library are not
# detected, as it isn't instrumented (that needs nightly Rust with -Zsanitizer=address).
set(SANITIZERS -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
foreach(test test_gml_reader test_geometry test_traffic_space)
    add_executable(${test} tests/${test}.c)
    target_include_directories(${test} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
    target_link_libraries(${test} PRIVATE "${ECITYGML_FFI}" unity m)
    target_compile_definitions(${test} PRIVATE ECITYGML_FIXTURES="${FIXTURES}")
    target_compile_options(${test} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror ${SANITIZERS})
    target_link_options(${test} PRIVATE ${SANITIZERS})
    set_target_properties(${test} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR}")
    add_test(NAME ${test} COMMAND ${test})
endforeach()

# Examples, also run as tests against the expected output shared by all languages.
add_subdirectory(examples)

# Snippets, run as tests the same way.
add_subdirectory(examples/snippets)
